desc: Apps that help people drink less alcohol or quit drinking.

personas.name: Emily
personas.bio: Emily is a college student who has realized her weekend binge drinking is spiraling out of control. She feels ashamed and is desperate to stop completely, but is unsure where to start.
personas.motivation: Very High - wants to quit entirely and needs immediate support and a clear path.

personas.name: Robert
personas.bio: Robert is a recently retired teacher who has been drinking daily for decades but now wants to quit for his grandchildren. He's not very tech-savvy and needs a straightforward, encouraging interface.
personas.motivation: High - driven by family and health, seeking a simple and supportive tool to quit.

tasks.title: Set the sobriety date and pledge
tasks.task: Upon first launch, enter the 'sober date' and make a daily pledge to commit to sobriety.
tasks.success: The user has successfully entered their sobriety start date and confirmed their daily pledge within the app.

tasks.title: Explore the 'Milestones' section
tasks.task: Find and view the initial milestones (e.g., 1 day, 1 week sober) to understand the app's progress tracking.
tasks.success: The user has navigated to the 'Milestones' or 'Progress' section and seen the upcoming sobriety milestones.
